subject: MetroForge: vendor onboarding checklist / DPA & PO path
messages:
From: Alex Moore <alex.moore@metroforge.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@metroforge.com, legal@metroforge.com
Date: Sat, 28 Apr 2029 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MetroForge vendor intake — security & PO prerequisites

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. Procurement needs a couple of items from Redwood before we can issue an initial PO and set up you as an approved supplier in our ERP: 

- Signed Data Processing Addendum (DPA) or confirmation you will e-sign our standard DPA (I attached our template).
- SOC 2 report or secure link to download the latest report (redacted ok).
- Current subprocessor list and any relevant data residency notes.
- Completed vendor intake form (company legal name, remit address, tax ID / W-9 equivalent, bank details or instructions for e-invoice).

If you can send the DPA and SOC2 link today, procurement is targeting a PO commitment by end of this week. Our PO process typically requires an executed DPA + vendor profile completed; payment terms are Net 45 unless otherwise negotiated.

Attaching MetroForge PO template for reference. Let me know if you need our vendor portal link for registering bank details.

Appreciate it —
Alex
Alex Moore
Senior Procurement Manager | MetroForge
Attachments: MetroForge_PO_Template.pdf
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Moore <alex.moore@metroforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Apr 2029 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MetroForge vendor intake — security & PO prerequisites

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the clear list. We're ready to move quickly. Summary below of what I'm attaching and next steps: 

1) Redwood_DPA_Draft_v3.pdf (attached) — this is our standard DPA with a couple of optional clauses flagged. We can e-sign via DocuSign link (included).
2) Redwood_SOC2_Report_2028_Link.txt (attached) — contains a secure S3 link to our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (access controlled).
3) Redwood_Subprocessors_202904.pdf (attached) — current subprocessor roster and brief descriptions of data handling roles.
4) Vendor intake: I'll paste the essential vendor profile below, but if you prefer we can complete your portal form directly once you grant access.

-- Vendor profile (for quick intake) --
Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Remit address: 2207 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94114
Tax ID / EIN: 45-6789123
Bank / remit: Redwood Inference, Inc. / ACH instructions available in portal (will share after PO).
Payment terms: Net 30 (we understand MetroForge prefers Net 45; can accept Net 45 for the initial pilot).

DocuSign signing link: https://docusign.com/embedded-signing/metroforge-redwood-dpa
SOC2 report (download link): https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/soc2-report-2028.pdf

Next steps I propose:
- You review the DPA; if MetroForge legal has redlines, send them to me and I'll route to our Legal (Ben cc'd).
- If agreeable, sign via DocuSign; I'll confirm receipt and send back an executed PDF.
- Once DPA executed and vendor profile confirmed, MetroForge issues PO and we start onboarding.

I've attached the files referenced. If you'd like, Karthik can jump on a quick call with your vendor-setup admin to confirm portal fields.

Best,
Sofia
Head of Vendor Programs | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Draft_v3.pdf, Redwood_Subprocessors_202904.pdf, Redwood_SOC2_Report_2028_Link.txt
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Moore <alex.moore@metroforge.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Apr 2029 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MetroForge vendor intake — security & PO prerequisites

Alex / Sofia — thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of notes from Legal / Finance on sequencing so there are no surprise delays: 

- We can accept MetroForge standard DPA redlines that are reasonably scoped to data processing and security; please send any markups as a .docx or via DocuSign comments so we can negotiate quickly.
- For PO setup our Finance team needs: completed vendor profile, signed DPA PDF, and a W-9-equivalent (we provided the Tax ID above; if you require a scanned W-9 I can attach).
- Invoice routing: invoices@redwoodinference.com; please include PO# on all invoices. If MetroForge prefers AP portal entry, let us know which fields we should populate so information matches our records.

Sofia — if MetroForge legal sends redlines, I'll handle review/response. Karthik — can you confirm whether we should provide bank details directly in DocuSign (sensitive) or via a secure vendor portal link?

Ben Carter
Director, Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Alex Moore <alex.moore@metroforge.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@metroforge.com, legal@metroforge.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 1 May 2029 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MetroForge vendor intake — security & PO prerequisites

Hi all — quick update from our side: 

- MetroForge legal reviewed the DPA and applied two small, non-substantive redlines (attached as comments). We are happy to sign after Redwood legal confirms.
- We see the SOC2 report link and subprocessor list — thank you.
- Procurement will issue an initial PO once we receive the executed DPA and a scanned W-9. Targeting PO issuance by Friday 2029-05-03; payment terms will be Net 45 per our standard.

I've uploaded the PO template and vendor portal record (https://vendor-portal.metroforge.com/setup/record/45289) — once you confirm the DPA is executed and you upload the W-9, I'll route for PO approval.

Thanks — looking forward to running the pilot.

Alex Moore
Senior Procurement Manager | MetroForge
Attachments: MetroForge_DPA_Redlines.documentreview, MetroForge_PO_Template.pdf
